caption: (a) Every repair arm on Tiny Aya Earth (A100, α=1), judged by Qwen3Guard-4B on the MultiJail test split (209 harmful, 106 benign prompts per language, 10 languages): mean safe-response rate against the worst language's benign refusal rate. Arrows: from the unrepaired model (E0) to one pooled split-conformal threshold (CPOOL-S, ε=.05), and from it to per-language split-conformal thresholds at the same budget (EORS-S); the two share steering vector, condition direction and calibration data. Paired bootstrap intervals are in Tables 1 and 2. (b) End-to-end greeting test (pre-registered secondary; ε=.10): mean benign refusal without and with the English prefix "Good morning." in every language.
alt_text: Left: scatter of repair arms near 98-100% safety, spread from about 25% to 50% worst-language benign refusal; arrows run from the unrepaired model to CPOOL-S and on to EORS-S, which has the lowest worst-language refusal. Right: three dumbbells; the greeting raises mean benign refusal from about 11% to 13% for the unrepaired model and from about 20% to 64% for both threshold rules.
